<thought>Analyzing the spectrum, the peaks show a regular ~1 Da spacing with alternating ~1.003 Da (characteristic of ¹³C) and ~0.994 Da (characteristic of ¹⁵N or ³³S). This pattern is sufficient to confirm the presence of carbon and nitrogen. No distinct 2 Da chlorine or bromine patterns are observed, and sulfur’s minor isotopic contributions are not unambiguous. Therefore, the elements that can be definitively identified are carbon and nitrogen.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'N']</final_answer>
